name: Opening Breach
summary: The first episode opens at the gate where secrecy, procedure, and old trust collide.
purpose: Introduce the city's record economy, the stolen ledger, and the personal fracture between Mira and Jun.
entry_conditions: Mira has already stolen the ledger.
The Office has already raised inspection pressure.
target_changes: Jun learns Mira is tied to the missing ledger.
Mira learns the inspection surge started from inside the Office.
